instruction: Navigate to United Airlines' special assistance services webpage.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate from United Airlines homepage to the special assistance/needs services page. Uses existing evaluator functions (is_expected_url_pattern_match metric + active_tab_info getter) to verify the active tab URL matches the expected special needs page pattern. Maintains similar difficulty level as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: agent should navigate to United Airlines special assistance services page
Getter 'get_active_tab_info' appropriately extracts the active tab URL from Chrome accessibility tree and navigates to verify the URL
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL contains 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/special-needs'
Expected URL pattern is semantically correct for the United Airlines special assistance/needs page
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (accessing the specific page)
Data flow is correct: active tab URL -> getter extracts -> metric compares against expected pattern -> returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: The getter 'get_active_tab_info' has a warning about potential page reloading issues with cached/cookie-dependent URLs. However, this is not a problem for this publicly accessible United Airlines page with no authentication requirements
The evaluator would benefit from a postconfig to ensure focus remains on the Chrome window, though this is not critical for this simple single-tab navigation task
